raw_response:
I have no schooling and finding money for fertilizer is very difficult for a woman like me. We will work this plot with our own hands — my children and grandchildren — because paying ganyu workers is too costly. I will spread manure from our goats on the field, but I cannot afford chemical fertilizer or hybrid seed from the agro-dealer. We depend only on the rains, and for maize we do not use any sprayed chemicals.
